title: SynScan simulator discovery can initialize a physical network mount
description:
The existing simulator autodetection case broadcasts to 255.255.255.255 and connects before checking that DEVICE_PORT is local. A physical mount can answer before the fixture (which drops five replies), receive connection/initialization commands, and the test then skips as a pass. Constrain discovery to loopback in the test build, retain real UDP parsing/retries and fail a nonlocal responder; verify before closure. Production hardware discovery must remain unchanged.

Imported from .factory/findings/archive/FND-20261023180923-1f46-fix-synscan-autohome-001.json (category: quality, blocking: no).
